LanguageData.LightForTheAbsent_Setting_Moodlets_Desc: Returning colonists remember the light, partners sleep lightly while the other is away, and family grieves when the light of someone who died far away goes out.
LanguageData.LightForTheAbsent_Setting_Message: Message when a light goes out
LanguageData.LightForTheAbsent_Setting_Message_Desc: Show a short message when the light of a colonist who died far from home goes out for good.
LanguageData.LightForTheAbsent_Setting_Brightness_Des: How bright the light is. At 100% it is about as bright as a single candle: enough to see in an empty room, too dim to work by. Changes reach lights already burning within a few seconds.
LanguageData.LightForTheAbsent_LightWentOutMessage: The light in {PAWN_nameDef}'s room has gone out.
